import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import re
import glob
from collections import defaultdict
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

# --- Configuration ---
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def find_csv(directory, keyword=""):
    matches = glob.glob(os.path.join(directory, f"*{keyword}*.csv"))
    return matches[0] if matches else None

TRAIN_PATH = find_csv(INPUT_DIR, "train") or "./input/ru_train.csv"
TEST_PATH = find_csv(INPUT_DIR, "test") or "./input/ru_test.csv"
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = find_csv(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission") or "./input/ru_sample_submission.csv"

print(f"Loading data from {TRAIN_PATH} and {TEST_PATH}...")
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)

# Clean training data
df_train.dropna(subset=["after"], inplace=True)
df_train["before"] = df_train["before"].astype(str).str.strip()
df_test["before"] = df_test["before"].astype(str).str.strip()

# --- Strict Sentence-Level Split ---
print("Performing strict sentence-level split to prevent leakage...")
train_sents = df_train["sentence_id"].unique()
train_sents_val, train_sents_holdout = train_test_split(train_sents, test_size=0.05, random_state=42, shuffle=True)

mask_val = df_train["sentence_id"].isin(train_sents_val)
df_trn = df_train[~mask_val].reset_index(drop=True)
df_val = df_train[mask_val].reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"Split sizes -> Train: {len(df_trn)}, Validation: {len(df_val)}")

# --- Improved Class Inference ---
def infer_class(series):
    s = series.copy()
    cl = pd.Series("PLAIN", index=s.index)
    
    # Punctuation
    cl[s.str.match(r'^[\.,;:\-—!?\(\)…""«»…\u2014\u2013]+$|^[\s]+$', na=False)] = "PUNCT"
    # Transliteration
    cl[s.str.contains("_trans", na=False)] = "TRANS"
    # Numerics: integers, decimals, fractions, ranges
    cl[s.str.match(r'^\d+(\.\d+)?(/[ ]*\d+(\.\d+)?)?([-–−]\d+(\.\d+)?)?$', na=False)] = "CARDINAL"
    # Times
    cl[s.str.match(r'^\d{1,2}:\d{2}(:\d{2})?$', na=False)] = "TIME"
    # Dates (numeric slash/dash or month keywords)
    date_mask = s.str.match(r'^\d{1,2}[/\-\.]\d{1,2}$', na=False) | s.str.contains(
        r'(февр|янв|март|апр|май|июн|июл|авг|сен|окт|ноя|дек|марта|января|года|число)', na=False, case=False
    )
    cl[(date_mask) & (cl == "PLAIN")] = "DATE"
    # Ordinals (ends with typical russian ordinal suffixes or 'году/ом' near numbers)
    ordinal_mask = s.str.match(r'^\d+(\.[аеиоуыэюё]*)?$|^\d+-(ой|ый|ий|яя|ее|ие)$', na=False)
    cl[(ordinal_mask) & (cl == "PLAIN")] = "ORDINAL"
    
    return cl

print("Inferring classes...")
df_trn["cls"] = infer_class(df_trn["before"])
df_val["cls"] = infer_class(df_val["before"])

# --- Lookup Model Construction ---
def build_lookup(table, cls_col):
    counts = table.groupby(["before", cls_col, "after"]).size().reset_index(name="cnt")
    counts.sort_values("cnt", ascending=False, inplace=True)
    best = counts.drop_duplicates(subset=["before", cls_col], keep="first")
    return {(row["before"], row[cls_col]): row["after"] for _, row in best.iterrows()}

print("Building lookup model on inner training split...")
lookup_map = build_lookup(df_trn, "cls")
print(f"Lookup size: {len(lookup_map)}")

# --- Prediction & Evaluation ---
def predict(tokens, classes, mapping):
    preds = []
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"
    for b, c in zip(tokens.values, classes.values):
        b_norm = b.strip().strip('„“”"«»'''' ')
        b_orig = b
        
        # Hierarchy: Exact(Clean,Class) -> Exact(Clean,Unknown) -> Exact(Raw,Class) -> Exact(Raw,Unknown) -> Raw
        if (b_norm, c) in mapping:
            preds.append(mapping[(b_norm, c)])
        elif (b_norm, UNKNOWN) in mapping:
            preds.append(mapping[(b_norm, UNKNOWN)])
        elif (b_orig, c) in mapping:
            preds.append(mapping[(b_orig, c)])
        elif (b_orig, UNKNOWN) in mapping:
            preds.append(mapping[(b_orig, UNKNOWN)])
        else:
            preds.append(b_orig)
    return preds

val_preds = predict(df_val["before"], df_val["cls"], lookup_map)
val_acc = np.mean(val_preds == df_val["after"].values)
print(f"\n=== Hold-Out Validation Accuracy: {val_acc:.6f} ===\n")

# --- Final Submission Preparation ---
print("Preparing final submission with full-dataset lookup...")
df_full = df_train.copy()
df_full["cls"] = infer_class(df_full["before"])
full_map = build_lookup(df_full, "cls")

test_infer = infer_class(df_test["before"])
test_preds = predict(df_test["before"], test_infer, full_map)

df_test["id"] = df_test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + df_test["token_id"].astype(str)
sub_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": df_test["id"], "after": test_preds})
sub_df.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, 'submission.csv')} ({len(sub_df)} rows)")
print("Done.")
